title: Mother Superior EA just had its best live week so far
author: Livid_Parsnip_2816
selftext:
**Mother Superior EA just had its best live week so far**

Four months of building and testing, and it’s nice to finally see her trading live.

This week finished at **+7.74%**, bringing October to **+21.46%**. The screenshot shows the daily breakdown, including the days without trades.

Mother Superior is my multi-strategy gold EA for MT5. It uses a recovery layer, so the closed results are only part of the picture — floating drawdown and combined exposure matter too. The live history is still short, but I’m pleased with the start.

Disclosure: I’m the developer, and the EA is available commercially.
